verdict.rationale: The machine-payments docs say refunds on agent payments go through the standard Refunds API and Dashboard. Agent-placed ACS orders also run on standard Stripe rails, as PaymentIntents tagged per agent. Refunds initiated by agents through the MCP server need human approval, so they are not fully programmatic. Missing for 10: refund flows documented specifically for ACS/ACP agent checkout orders, refund status tracking or refund webhooks for agent orders, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, refunds on agent-placed orders can be initiated and tracked programmatically

citations.quote: with refunds available through the standard Refunds API and Dashboard per the features table
Stripe requires human confirmation before it takes certain `stripe_api_write` actions, such as refunds and outbound payments.
Each order generates a unique `checkout.session.completed` event.
